Name: Don't Stop Me Now
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Move while swinging weapons/tools and aiming slingshots. Rotate while charging tools. Swing where you click, not move.[/size]

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=5]Settings:[/size]
Defaults are underlined.
[list]
[*][b][font=Courier New]SlowMove[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]MoveWhileSwingingTools[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New]true[/font]/[font=Courier New][u]false[/u][/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]MoveWhileSwingingMeleeWeapons[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]MoveWhileSpecial[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]MoveWhileAimingSlingshot[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]MoveWhileChargingTools[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New]true[/font]/[font=Courier New][u]false[/u][/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixToolFacing[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixMeleeWeaponFacing[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixChargingToolFacing[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixFishingRodFacing[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixFacingOnMouse[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New][u]true[/u][/font]/[font=Courier New]false[/font]
[*][b][font=Courier New]FixFacingOnController[/font][/b]: [font=Courier New]true[/font]/[font=Courier New][u]false[/u][/font]
[/list]

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/DontStopMeNow]here[/url].
